description: Returns platform stock programs (publisher programs). Use when the user wants to browse or clone stock programs. Not for the team's own programs (use list_team_programs).

difficulties.description: Only show these levels, e.g. ["beginner", "intermediate"]. Omit for all levels.

duration_in_weeks.description: Only show programs this many weeks long, e.g. 4.

goal_ids.description: Only show programs with any of these goals. IDs from list_team_goals.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

search_text.description: Text to search names for, e.g. "core". Omit to list everything.

sort_order.description: Sort direction: "ascend" (A to Z, lowest or oldest first) or "descend" (reverse).

workouts_per_week.description: Only show programs with this many workouts per week, e.g. 3.

name: list_stock_programs
title: List stock programs
